title: Gold Account: Gold Rewards Card holder benefits
summary: Gold Account holders with a Gold Rewards Card get a reduced minimum balance of $5,000 (standard $10,000), plus a relationship bonus APY of 0.025% added to the base 5.5% rate (total shown as 6.0% in example). They also receive up to $30/month ATM fee rebates and up to 20 withdrawals per month.
